name: B10-0463/2026 (PPE) – Human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on human rights in Iran and naming two women, Leila Abolhasani and Taraneh Rahimi, who have been sentenced to death. It condemns those sentences, calls for the women to be freed, and asks Iran to stop executions and release people held arbitrarily. It also asks European Union countries to sanction those responsible and to watch the trials of people detained for using their basic rights.

- The text is an opinion, not a law; no rules change.
- It targets Iran's authorities and two women facing execution.
- Next: European Union governments are asked to consider sanctions and trial monitoring.
